Metadata.title: PokéCompanion
Metadata.description: Tools for Pokémon players: Pokédex, team builder, type calculator and collection tracker.

Header.toggleTheme: Switch between light and dark mode

Home.title: Pokédex, teams and collection in one place
Home.intro: PokéCompanion brings together the tools you reach for while playing: look up a Pokémon, check which types hit it hard, build a team and keep track of what you've caught.
Home.typesIntro: The foundation of almost everything: each type has its own colour, and you'll see it the same way in the Pokédex, in teams and in the calculator.
Home.roadmapIntro: The site ships in stages. This is the order the tools will arrive in:

pokedex.name: Pokédex
pokedex.description: A full entry for every Pokémon: stats, types, abilities and moves.

typeCalculator.name: Type calculator
typeCalculator.description: Pick one or two types and see their weaknesses and resistances at a glance.

evolutions.name: Evolutions
evolutions.description: Evolution chains with the exact method: level, item, friendship or trade.

database.name: Moves, abilities and items
database.description: Search any move, ability or item and find out which Pokémon use it.

accounts.name: Trainer profile
accounts.description: Your account, your preferences and a dashboard with your activity.

teamBuilder.name: Team builder
teamBuilder.description: Build teams of six and spot coverage gaps before you battle.

collection.name: Collection
collection.description: Mark the Pokémon you own, including shinies and regional forms.

community.name: Community
community.description: Share teams and collections with other trainers.

NotFound.title: Nothing here
NotFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.
